content: drawterm forks: 9fans/drawterm (rsc original, 164 commits, gui-osx/gui-x11, no wayland) speaks p9sk1 natively. 9front fork (git.9front.org/plan9front/drawterm, github mirror 607 commits, maintained) adds dp9ik + TLS rcpu, gui-cocoa/gui-x11/gui-wl/gui-fbdev; VERIFIED from its cpu.c source: p9any() still accepts p9sk1@dom, gettickets() falls back to mkservertickets() (direct auth without an auth server when authid==hostid), ncpu() path (old cpu protocol, dial service ncpu/17010, p9any + rc4_256/sha1 ssl via pushssl) exactly matches Harvey cpu.c server side (p9authproto=p9any, ealgs='rc4_256 sha1'); without -O it tries rcpu first then falls back to ncpu on dial failure, so -O is recommended but not strictly required. Conclusion: use 9front fork (maintained, cocoa native on macOS) — it fully supports Harvey's legacy p9sk1 cpu service.
